subject: MAP Kickoff: EU Data Residency & Cross-Border Review — Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Dupont <sofie.dupont@eu-retail.co>, Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@eu-retail.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: MAP Kickoff: EU Data Residency & Cross-Border Review — Next Steps

Hi Sofie / Luca —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I’ve put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on timeline, owners, and the specific data residency checkpoints we’ll need to clear for your EU rollout. The initial plan is attached (MAP_EU_Retail_Rollout_v1.xlsx) — it’s a lightweight tracker with milestones and owners.

High-level proposed milestones (suggested dates):
- Security questionnaire & evidence exchange: target complete by 2026-03-20
- Data flow diagram & KMS design review: 2026-03-27
- Pilot (subset of EU traffic): start 2026-04-15
- Procurement & contract signature: 2026-04-30
- Production/GA: 2026-06-30

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Please confirm the key stakeholders on your side who should be on the MAP and who will sign off on data residency and legal items.
2) Confirm any hard constraints (regulatory deadlines, procurement windows).
3) Quick availability for a 30-minute kickoff next week — I’ve proposed a slot (link below).

What we’ll cover on the call:
- Roles & responsibilities (who owns evidence, who signs contract)
- Data residency options (hosted EU region, private VPC, on-premise options)
- Evidence list and timelines (SOC2, encryption, KMS, audit logs)
- Next actions and owner assignments in the MAP

Attachments: MAP_EU_Retail_Rollout_v1.xlsx (action owner tracker)
Related links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MAP-EU, calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/20260309-30m

We’ll keep this light and pragmatic — happy to iterate the MAP once you confirm stakeholders.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sofie Dupont <sofie.dupont@eu-retail.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@eu-retail.co>, Legal Team <legal@eu-retail.co>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: EU Data Residency & Cross-Border Review — Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Confirming stakeholders from our side:
- Sofie Dupont — Project Lead / Product (me)
- Luca Rossi — Engineering lead (technical review)
- Ana Martinez — Data Protection Officer (dpo@eu-retail.co) — I’ve cc’d Legal Team; Ana will want to lead the GDPR / cross-border discussion
- Thomas Berger — Procurement (will handle contract windows)

Hard constraints: procurement completion ideally by 2026-04-30; production readiness target end of June is realistic for us but depends on evidence turnaround. We are particularly concerned about:
- Cross-border transfer mechanics post-Schrems II (do you offer EU-only processing and keys?)
- KMS details: can keys be customer-managed or region locked?

Can you share an initial data scope doc? I attached our EU_Retail_Data_Scope.pdf (high level) so you can see the categories we’ll want to follow. Also, we’ll need a data flow diagram showing where tokens/inputs and any logs leave the EU, if they do.

I’m available for the proposed 30-minute slot on Tue 9 Mar at 10:00 CET — I’ll join with Ana if she’s available.

Best,
Sofie
Head of Product, EU Retail Co.
sofie.dupont@eu-retail.co
Attachment: EU_Retail_Data_Scope.pdf

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: EU Data Residency & Cross-Border Review — Next Steps

Hi all — thanks Sofie, good notes. A few technical clarifications to help Ana / Legal before the kickoff:

Short answers up-front:
- EU-only processing: yes — we can pin workloads to EU regions for the hosted API and offer a Private (VPC) deployment where all inference and logs remain inside the customer VPC and region.
- KMS options: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted accounts we offer regional keys with strict access controls and audit logs.
- Logs & telemetry: we can suppress debug logs and avoid storing request bodies in long-term logs; we provide token-level tracing only when enabled and with explicit consent.

Items I’ll prepare for the kickoff:
- A simple data flow diagram showing request path for hosted vs private (attached: redwood-data-residency-brief.pdf)
- KMS integration note (BYOK options + supported providers)
- Short checklist for evidence we can deliver within two weeks (SOC2 artefacts, encryption configuration, audit log examples)

If Ana/DPO would like a deeper technical session we can schedule a dedicated 60-minute run-through after the MAP kickoff.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-data-residency-brief.pdf

Hi Sofie / team —

Thanks for flagging the DPO and legal involvement. Quick security summary and what we can commit to deliver in the first evidence exchange (timeline below):

What Redwood can provide within 10 business days after kickoff:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted where necessary)
- Encryption config: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, and KMS integration guide for BYOK
- Audit log samples showing regional retention controls (we can produce slices that demonstrate EU-only retention policy)
- Data processing addendum (DPA) template and standard EU SCCs language we propose

Open points to confirm with you / Legal:
- Any requirement for HSM-backed keys exclusively (we support HSM via customer KMS providers)
- Whether metadata about request timing must be considered personal data in scope

Suggested timeline for evidence review:
- Kickoff meeting: this week (confirm Tue 9 Mar 10:00 CET)
- Evidence exchange window: 2026-03-03 -> 2026-03-17 (10 business days)
- Technical follow-up (if needed): week of 2026-03-22

Attachments I’ll drop into the shared Drive after this message: security-evidence-index.csv (index of items), sample_audit_log_excerpt.txt

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
